title: Which benchmarks does the paper mention for world models?
summary: The field has several partial benchmarks but no settled safety-critical standard.
body: The paper mentions VideoPhy and PhyGenBench for physical commonsense in generated video, WorldScore for controllability, quality and dynamics, WorldModelBench for judging video models as world models, WorldArena for usefulness in robot training, testing and planning, and LIBERO for simulated robot-manipulation tasks. It stresses that no settled benchmark is sufficient for safety-critical deployment.
